signal: Minitab was named to G2's 2026 Best Software Awards for data analytics, jumping to 17th overall after not ranking two years ago

email.body1:
Dan, saw Minitab jumped to 17th on G2's 2026 Best Software Awards for data analytics, a big climb from not ranking two years ago.

Momentum like that usually means more in-market accounts worth a conversation than your team can reach before it cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Minitab off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for Minitab.

Running revenue programs, you know most teams can't pin down how many meetings each program actually needs to hit target, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Minitab needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for Minitab.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Minitab's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Dan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running revenue programs through a growth stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a revenue-programs motion? I'll tailor it to Minitab either way.
